sources.researchNote: The article presents Gmeindl primarily as a pedagogue. It gives 31 December 1890 at Hainburg an der Donau as his date of birth and 1 September 1958 at Hainburg as his date of death, and traces his appointments at the Munich Hofoper from 1915. Schreker engaged him in Berlin as a Dozent in 1922 and, in 1929, as professor of composition and head of the orchestra school of the Musikhochschule, where he later took the conducting class as well; Sergiu Celibidache and Ernst Pepping were among his pupils. It is the teaching post held during Kaper’s Berlin years, which the archive documents in the event of private study, 1926–1930. The lexicon spells the forename Walter, without the h in the archive’s person record. The live entry explicitly labels 25 April 2003 as “Letzte inhaltliche Änderung” (last content update). This is the date recorded here; it is not an independently established first-publication date.
